description: Moved <meta charset>, viewport, X-UA-Compatible, theme-color to be the first tags in <head> (HTML spec compliance — must be in first 1024 bytes)
expected_impact: Faster early parsing and SEO; prevents charset reparse

description: Deferred GA4 (gtag.js) to load on first user interaction (scroll/click/touch/key/mouse) or after 3s timeout — matches existing GTM/Clarity/Bing pattern
expected_impact: Reduces TBT and main-thread blocking on initial load (~150ms+)

description: Added preconnect for cdn.shopify.com and www.googletagmanager.com; added dns-prefetch for cdn.jsdelivr.net, www.clarity.ms, checkout-merchant.snapmint.com
Added defer attribute to slick-carousel JS loaded from jsdelivr (was render-blocking)
expected_impact: Removes render-blocking script on non-index/product pages

description: Slick-carousel CSS now uses media=print + onload swap pattern with noscript fallback (was render-blocking)
Snapmint payment script (mid=6233) now only loads on product/cart/checkout templates instead of every page
Merged three separate inline <style> blocks (.whatsapp FadeIn, article-only, main) into one block; removed extra whitespace within rules
expected_impact: Slightly smaller HTML payload and fewer style recalculations

description: Replaced broken inline aspect-ratio cascade (img position:absolute caused ancestor height collapse) with aspect-ratio:16/9 directly on .swiper-slide. Slide height is now reserved before Swiper initializes
Removed opacity:0 → carousel-ready hack. First slide now visible immediately on paint
expected_impact: Improves LCP timing for above-fold carousel

description: Replaced dual (desktop+mobile both eager+fetchpriority=high) with single element using on first slide. Browser fetches only the matching image
expected_impact: Saves one full image download (~200-500KB) on every visit

description: Removed legacy inline <style> that absolute-positioned images out of normal flow (was the root cause of the CLS chain)
expected_impact: Cleaner cascade; allows external CSS to drive layout

description: Extracted 4× duplicated chevron-down SVG paths into snippets icon-account-chevron-mb.liquid and icon-account-chevron-dec.liquid (rendered 2× each)
expected_impact: Reduces HTML payload by ~1KB per page and improves cacheability

description: Minified inline <style> block: removed comment, collapsed whitespace, single-line rules
expected_impact: Smaller HTML payload sent on every page

description: Gated cart-notification.js to only load when settings.cart_type == 'notification' (previously loaded on every page)
expected_impact: Saves a JS request when cart_type is drawer/page
